channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Malala Yousafzai — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-04
item.description: “When the whole world is silent, even one voice becomes powerful.” — Malala Yousafzai

item.title: Dogen — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-03
item.description: “To carry yourself forward and experience myriad things is delusion. That myriad things come forth and experience themselves is awakening.” — Dogen

item.title: Jawaharlal Nehru — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
item.description: “Action to be effective must be directed to clearly conceived ends.” — Jawaharlal Nehru

item.title: Muhammad Yunus — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “All human beings are born entrepreneurs.” — Muhammad Yunus

item.title: Dalai Lama — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “A disciplined mind leads to happiness, and an undisciplined mind leads to suffering.” — Dalai Lama

item.title: Wayne Dyer — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “How people treat you is their karma; how you react is yours.” — Wayne Dyer

item.title: Elon Musk — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “Persistence is very important. You should not give up unless you are forced to give up.” — Elon Musk

item.title: Georg Lichtenberg — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-28
item.description: “I cannot say whether things will get better if we change; what I can say is they must change if they are to get better.” — Georg Lichtenberg
